main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). Premier South Coast venue featuring a 1,600m oval and a generous 400m home straight with a distinct +1.5m uphill elevation rise to the finish post. The 400m uphill stretch acts as a true stamina test, giving closing swoopers ('S') and strong-finishing pressers ('P') ample opportunity to wind up and catch tired front-runners.
main_turf.post_bias: Fair across middle distances. In 1000m and 1200m sprint dashes, inside-to-middle barriers (stalls 1–5) hold a minor advantage to secure early positioning before entering the home bend.

handicapping_angles.uphill_400m_stretch_stamina_boost: Nowra's 400m uphill straight tests late sectional stamina. Do not automatically favor one-dimensional speed horses if early pace is contested; upgrade strong L400m closers ('Swoopers').
handicapping_angles.kembla_and_sydney_shippers: Nowra receives high-volume provincial and metropolitan shippers from Kembla Grange (Paul Murray, Robert & Luke Price, Joseph Ible) and Sydney (Bjorn Baker, Waterhouse & Bott, Chris Waller). Upgrade shippers stepping down into Nowra country benchmark company (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.nowra_cup_showcase_class: During the Nowra Cup ($100k+ Showcase) feature meeting in December, race quality elevates to Provincial/Metro grade. Factor in higher speed par offsets for Cup day feature races.
